title: helm's surfaces.json
description: Which backend each seam of the asks and the board takes, in order of preference. The file is the owner's, linked into the regatta config dir as helm/surfaces.json (SURFACES_FILE overrides it); a missing file or row reads as bin/surfaces.py's DEFAULTS. Each enum here is surfaces.KNOWN's, kept equal by tests/check.sh.

_.description: a note for the reader; ignored

plan.description: the helm row's name before rename S5, read as helm's

notify.description: two shapes side by side (charterer S3). The ladder keys: update, question and stall, each a list of rungs fired in order, once per message, at `after` from its first moment while it is unanswered; quiet, the hours every phone-reaching rung holds; cap, phone-reaching pushes an hour. Every other key is the old row per host — an ask's by surfaces.host(), a stall's by helmlib.host() (the yard's own name, never cloud): an ask nobody relays rings its banner, and a kind with no ladder reads the row as one rung, sent as before the ladder (bin/ask notice(); github-issue carries stalls only)

hours.description: HH:MM-HH:MM in tz, else the host's local time; may wrap past midnight; equal ends are the whole day

tz.description: an IANA time zone ("America/Los_Angeles"); absent: the host's local time

oneOf.description: one backend: a row an older --set wrote as a string

hail.description: wharf-runs' hail: the roads a hail may take, in order; the target's own road (socket, codex or orca) always goes first, then talk, mailbox and file in this row's order; a road left out is never taken

ladder.description: one rung per channel: a channel named twice keeps its first rung

after.description: "10m", "90s", "1h30m" or seconds, at most a year (366 days); 0 when absent

when.description: hold the rung until the owner is at the Mac; null: no condition, as absent
